Analysis history

Planner batches remain available in this browser. NVV and rehandle results are included only when a yard snapshot was supplied.

Planning dateTerminalVesselsNetwork / SSPlanner movesNVV exceptionsRehandles

No saved analyses yet.

01

Planner moves

Each valid LOAD or DSCH row is assigned to the WI Planner. Batch totals combine all selected Work Lists.

02

Short steaming

Short steaming is selected manually for each detected vessel. GEN_CARRIER never marks a vessel as SS.

03

Optional yard

Work Lists alone calculate planner KPIs. NVV, rehandles and Yard Inventory activate only when a yard snapshot is added.

04

NVV source

Expected NVV comes from WI Outbound Carrier. Yard NVV comes from O/B Actual Visit.

05

Rehandle model

Each vessel is simulated separately in WI move-time order. A blocker is counted once, then treated as relocated.

06

Local processing

Files are read inside this browser. History stores calculated results, not the uploaded source files.
